alex: Heads-up — doing a last-minute run-of-show check for today's all-hands. Quick ask: can someone verify slide sync and encoder health in ~15m? I might swap roadmap/ops order.
maya: On it. Pinged ops and prepping a quick encoder smoke test. @linda can you monitor captions?
linda: Watching captions. I'll watch live captions + yt ingest. Will call out if latency >3s.
jamal: Encoder metrics look green now, but saw a micro-stutter last night at ~2k viewers. Adding a tiny ingest buffer: `/set-ingest-buf 300ms`
stream-bot: Recording scheduled to start in 12 minutes. Reminder: /start-recording at 14:00 UTC.
alex: Thanks — if captions drop, fallback is record-only + upload transcript. Maya, keep backup OBS ready?
maya: Backup OBS ready. Also enabling re-sync helper:
```
# re-sync helper
obs-cli --scene "Allhands"
obs-cli --start-recording
```
jamal: If encoder CPU spikes we'll flip to second region (route us-west-2 -> us-east-2). I'll prep a canary route.
linda: Caption provider pinged. If captions lag >5s we'll show a 'Captions delayed' banner :warning:
morgan: I'll be on mic at 13:55 for a mic check. Good luck everyone :rocket:
